# The form-picker head file uses a bare shared helper rather than a module-shaped wrapper

D241600 first requests a head file instead of a module, then asks to keep checkABrowser as a bare function because the file is loaded as a head and no additional FormPickerTestUtils members are expected. The landed and fixed file follow that shape; the revision title is corrected too. Reuse the existing harness lesson for environment tags and script loading. This is a decision for the actual small shared helper and harness, not a blanket ban on modules or utility objects. No browser test ran.

Scope: Browser test helper organization.
